title: Software Consulting Engineer
teaser: We are looking for a Software Consulting Engineer to drive optimisation and technology design for Cisco solutions. You will support end-to-end development and deployment, collaborating with teams to deliver high-level designs. Ideal candidates have experience in software development or technical consulting and strong programming skills.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Job Description

Meet the Team 
 

CX is a team of outstanding technical guides whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience. We help take on the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer and partner success and dedication. Our success is validated through outstanding financial results, growing customer happiness metrics, industry recognition, and employee happiness scores.
 

Your Impact 

Act as a key individual contributor to drive optimization, technology design, and implementation, directly accelerating customer business outcomes.

Assist customers with the end-to-end development, deployment, and integration of complex Cisco technologies and systems.

Build and utilize labs to validate solutions and resolve sophisticated compatibility issues.

Partner with internal and external resources to jointly deliver high-level designs (HLD), low-level designs (LLD), and implementation plans.

Utilize specialized software skills to configure and deploy Cisco solutions while maintaining strict alignment with company policies and Professional Services goals.

Enjoy the excitement of shaping customer architecture and solving complex technical challenges while working in a collaborative, project-focused environment. 
 

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech./BSC) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 2+ years of professional experience in software development or technical consulting.

Proficiency in programming using Java or Python.

Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix and networking fundamentals

Experience with software development lifecycles, including version control and debugging.

Knowledge of Data Structures & Algorithms, Database management and API design (RESTful services).
 

Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies.

Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and project management tools.

·       Well versed at software programmability, automation, orchestration and/or virtualization 

Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
